scripts.dev: GIT_REPOS_DIR="$INIT_CWD/../local/scratch-git-repos" sh -c 'stale_pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:3100 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$stale_pids" ] && echo "[dev] reclaiming ports 3100/3101 from stale scratch-git ($stale_pids)" && kill $stale_pids 2>/dev/null && sleep 1 && kill -9 $stale_pids 2>/dev/null; exec cargo run'
